_comment: Source of truth for the DEV vLLM serverless endpoint (issue #1). The intended settings live here; secrets and the endpoint id do not. The prod twin is endpoint.prod.json — different privacy posture, read its _privacy note.
name: vllm-ministral-dev
gpu_tier: 24GB Ada-generation or newer (L4 / RTX 4090 / RTX 4000 Ada) — the model ships FP8; Ampere cards (3090/A5000) hang at first forward pass

env.HF_TOKEN: supplied at creation from the operator's environment (create-endpoint.sh reads $HF_TOKEN) — never written into this file

_privacy: Dev keeps vLLM request logging ON deliberately — dev carries synthetic test data only and the logs are useful for debugging. PROD MUST NOT copy this: endpoint.prod.json sets DISABLE_LOG_REQUESTS=True (privacy-load-bearing).
_licensing: Ministral 3 (2512) family is Apache 2.0 — usable commercially. Do NOT substitute Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410: it is Mistral Research License (non-commercial).
_request_surface: OpenAI-compatible: https://api.runpod.ai/v2/<ENDPOINT_ID>/openai/v1/chat/completions with a Bearer key. Workers use a RESTRICTED endpoint-invocation-only key. Supports response_format json_schema (server-enforced structured output — the property the Mistral-API control run validated).
